visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair wearing a grey hoodie sits at a light-colored wooden table in a brightly lit indoor environment. She is smiling while unwrapping a brown paper food parcel with both hands. A red soda can sits to her right. The background shows a busy food court area with other diners and bright ceiling lights. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a blue and white sign reading 'D7' followed by a red wall with white Chinese calligraphy and English text about tradition. (3) The camera pans across the food court, showing walls decorated with pink cherry blossom petal graphics. It then showcases several restaurant fronts including 'Burger Land' with a black menu board, 'Sky Elephant Thai Restaurant' with a yellow elephant logo, and 'World's Best Coffee Shop' with an arched wooden frame. (4) The woman is shown again, holding a burger in a brown wrapper and taking a large bite. She chews with a satisfied expression. (5) The camera pans across a dark marble countertop equipped with international power outlets and USB ports. Through a large glass window behind the counter, an airport tarmac is visible. (6) A wide shot through the glass shows an EVA Air Boeing 777 aircraft with Hello Kitty livery parked on the tarmac. Service vehicles and ground crew are active around the plane under an overcast sky.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to inform travelers about the newly opened food court in Zone D of Taoyuan International Airport. It uses a first-person vlog perspective to showcase the variety of dining options (burger, Thai, coffee, beef noodles) and highlight convenient features like charging ports and the scenic view of the tarmac, encouraging viewers to visit this area when traveling.
